title: Assertion: Power-Good Never Drops
constraints: Rule: once `pwr_good` has been sampled high (outside reset), it must stay high at every following edge until the next reset.
Before it first rises it may be low for any number of cycles.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: `pwr_good |=> pwr_good`: if it is high now, it must be high next cycle.
A sticky flag works too: set on pwr_good, then assert `seen |-> pwr_good`.
`disable iff (rst)` restarts the obligation after each reset.
